notes:
Describes something that conforms to the norm or average for a given group. Often used in discussions of statistics, demographics, and general comparisons. Can carry a neutral or slightly negative nuance when implying mediocrity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平均的|へいきんてき}な⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧: average Japanese person
- {平均的|へいきんてき}な⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧: average income
- {平均的|へいきんてき}な⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧: average build
- {平均的|へいきんてき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: average lifestyle
- {平均的|へいきんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧: on average, looking at it from an average standpoint

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧: normal, ordinary — more colloquial and subjective; describes what is considered standard
- ⟦{標準的|ひょうじゅんてき}→標準的：05668_hyoujunteki⟧: standard, typical — implies conformity to an established norm or benchmark
- ⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧: general, common — describes what is widely shared or applicable

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧ (average, mean) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix).

definitions.explanation: representative of a statistical or general average; typical of a group or category; neither exceptionally good nor bad

examples.japanese: {平均的|へいきんてき}な⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧。
examples.english: The diet of an average Japanese person.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平均的|へいきんてき}だ。
examples.english: The temperature in this area is average.

examples.japanese: {平均的|へいきんてき}な⟦{会社員|かいしゃいん}→会社員：03018_kaishain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧400{万円|まんえん}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that the average office worker's annual income is about four million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平均的|へいきんてき}で、⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: His grades are average, and nothing stands out in particular.
